# dagsterplus_agent_token (Data Source)

Reads an existing Dagster+ agent token by label. The token value is not available via this data source — it is only accessible at creation time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dagsterplus_agent_token" "hybrid_agent" {
  name = "hybrid-agent-token"
}

output "agent_token_id" {
  value = data.dagsterplus_agent_token.hybrid_agent.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The label of the agent token to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The token ID assigned by Dagster+.
